VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms 31 tests pass and the package diff (ATT) confirms no dependency changes—satisfying criterion 2 and the "tests pass" portion of criterion 1. However, neither attested artifact demonstrates that the *specific* rounding drift bug was actually fixed; passing tests only prove the bug is fixed if a test exercises that defect. There is no evidence (e.g., a failing-then-passing regression test targeting the netting rounding drift, or a diff of the fix itself) that the rounding behavior was corrected. The claim that the fix addresses the bug rests on the self-report (SELF), which is not sufficient to confirm criterion 1.
